lines.zh: 我踩着湿藤走，脚下发亮。
lines.en: I walk the wet vines, feet glimmering.
I scatter little sparks as I go.

lines.zh: 手里的骨头杖点在地上。
lines.en: My bone staff taps the ground.
I circle the ritual stone once.

lines.zh: 我的毛被自己电得立起来。
lines.en: My own charge lifts my fur.
I slip out from behind the vine curtain.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，一步一步念。
lines.en: I walk slowly, muttering each step.
Each step makes the ground hum.
I keep clear of the leader's path.
I raise the staff to light my way.
I walk at the tail of the troop.
I sit with the staff across my knees.
I listen to the storm clouds.
I chant a few lines for them.

lines.zh: 我的指尖一直有小火花。
lines.en: Tiny sparks never leave my fingertips.
The lightning here is useful.
I arrange stones in a ring.
I don't charge at the front.

lines.zh: 我在数今天打了几次雷。
lines.en: I count today's thunderclaps.
The bone at the staff's head has gone white.
My eyes are grey.

lines.zh: 我在给同伴的拳头加压。
lines.en: I'm charging my kin's fists.

lines.zh: 这块石头被雷打过很多次。
lines.en: Lightning has struck this stone many times.

lines.zh: 我把杖在地上敲了两下。
lines.en: I tap the staff twice on the ground.
My breathing crackles.
I'm waiting for rain.
You're not of this troop.
There's no charge on you.
I could add some for you.
We take. We don't invite.
The iron you carry draws lightning.
Let me look at your frame.
This staff isn't a walking stick.
Don't stand inside the stone ring.

lines.zh: 你知道雷为什么打那儿吗？
lines.en: Do you know why lightning strikes there?

lines.zh: 你退出去，我们就当没见过。
lines.en: Leave, and we'll say we never met.

lines.zh: 我在算你经不经得起一下。
lines.en: I'm reckoning whether you'd take one hit.
The one behind you has a temper.
I don't like using my fists.
I prefer letting the sky do it.
My staff is knocked crooked.
I step back twice, short of breath.
My chant breaks mid-line.
The fur on my shoulder is singed.
I steady myself on a stone.
I don't cry out. Shamans don't.

lines.zh: 雷光从我伤口里漏出来。
lines.en: Lightning leaks from my wound.
The sparks left my fingertips.
I slowly start chanting again.
The thunder hasn't come yet. Don't gloat.
That isn't our way.
We don't eat that sort of thing.
Hold it higher; let me look.
Take that away.
We don't trade. We take.
That won't buy a thunderbolt.
I won't be distracted by that.
Don't put your hand in the ring.
Bribing a shaman?
Put it back. I'm chanting.
You knocked me and the staff nearly fell.
I step back and steady the staff.

lines.zh: 我身上有电，你手麻了吗？
lines.en: I'm charged. Is your hand numb?
I won't crowd you; I'll go around.
That broke my chant.
I raised the staff to block.
You stepped into the ring.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，电花溅了一地。
lines.en: Sparks scatter on the ground.
Touch me again and I stop being gentle.
Another shaman of my rank.
We tap staffs.
Its bone staff is older than mine.
We set the stones together.
Two shamans can stack their chants.
It chants a line; I take the next.
We sit back to back.
The rite done, we each withdraw.
Next storm season, together again.
I take what glints on the ground.
I nudge it with the staff's head.
This pearl could draw a charge.
I drop it into my waist pouch.
Everything dropped is an offering.
I press it under a stone.
I pick it up and mutter a line.
Stowed, I go back to chanting.
You've stepped into the ring.
I've raised the staff.
The sky will strike for me.
First I'll mark you.
This ground conducts.
The iron on you is conspicuous.
No rush. I'll finish the chant.
I've chosen where you stand.
The thunder is coming.

lines.zh: 雷云聚在我头顶，指向你。
lines.en: Storm clouds gather over me and point at you.
You can't get out; the vines are thick.
This one won't be my fist.
You moved; I remark you.
The staff head stays on you.
I wait for you to step in a puddle.
Clouds gather over your head.
Your armor pulls the charge down.
I don't shout. I chant.
You're at the ring's edge. Good.
I'm counting the gaps between strikes.
You're under a tree. It's wet.

lines.zh: 你每动一次，电就多一点。
lines.en: Every move adds charge.
I watch the ground under you.
I shake my bone rattle; thunder answers.

lines.zh: 我杖一挥，一道蓝光过去。
lines.en: I sweep the staff; a blue arc flies.
Lightning falls from the staff's head.
A scorch line is left on the ground.
The shock throws you back.
I tap your knee with the staff.
The charge still clings to you.
That one was for the wood.
I speak the final word.

lines.zh: 你的手抖得握不住东西。
lines.en: Your hand shakes too much to hold anything.
I pull back, staff still raised.

lines.zh: 我从雷击的地方站起来。
lines.en: I rise where the lightning struck.

lines.zh: 石圈亮了一下，我就到了。
lines.en: The stone ring flashes, and I'm here.
The staff lands first, then me.
The vine wall parts a crack.
The smell of thunder is still on me.

lines.zh: 他们让出了中间的位置。
lines.en: They leave me the middle place.
I count the stones. Enough.
The clouds hang lower.
My first staff-tap is loud.
I shake the ash from my shoulders.

lines.zh: 这里就是我该站的地方。
lines.en: This is where I'm meant to stand.
I speak the opening three words.
The wood quiets to listen.

lines.zh: 我的影子被电照得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long in the glow.
Fire tangles with my charge.
On landing my knees give.
The water washes my charge away.
The blast pins me down.
An arrow goes through my sleeve.
Another's spell overrides mine.
Hunger makes me mispronounce a word.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我笑着接下来。
lines.en: Lightning falls, and I take it smiling.
I fall, staff still raised.
